content.study:
Section 43K — Depository of awards

Section 43K provides for an electronic depository of arbitral awards made in India and related records to be maintained by the Arbitration Council of India in the manner specified by regulations.

The provision belongs to the Arbitration Council of India framework and must be read with applicable regulations and commencement notifications.
